recent.text: 3Q: Hawks 70, Celtics 69 Hawks got a Dyson Daniels switch onto Baylor Scheierman and he hit a floater. Then Jayson Tatum tried to go at Zuby Ejiofor and his layup fell short. Really good third from the Hawks to claw back into this one. They held the Celtics to 18 points.
recent.author: Lauren L. Williams

recent.text: Then they get a 3 from Johnson w/ 3:19 and the Hawks have cut this game to 67-63
